## Guía de funciones en R para regresión logística

<div class="block-definition fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div class="block-title" style="font-size: 28px;">Análisis completo paso a paso</div>
  <div class="block-body">
  <p class="text-justify" style="font-size: 28px;">
  Esta rutina cubre: ajuste del modelo, extracción de coeficientes, odds ratios, evaluación y diagnóstico. Los resultados se presentan con tablas para mantener la salida limpia y pedagógica.
  </p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="3">

<table style="width:100%; font-size: 26px; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;">
<thead>
<tr style="background-color: #1b4d2e; color: white;">
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 8%;">Paso</th>
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 22%;">Etapa</th>
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 50%;">Funciones en R</th>
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 20%;">Librería externa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">1</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Ajuste</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>glm(Y ~ X1 + X2, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = datos)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">2</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Resumen</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>summary(modelo)</code>, <code>confint(modelo)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">3</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Odds ratios</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>exp(coef(modelo))</code>, <code>exp(confint(modelo))</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">4</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Multicolinealidad</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>vif(modelo)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>car</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">5</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Comparación con el nulo</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>anova(modelo_nulo, modelo, test = "Chisq")</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">6</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Curva ROC y AUC</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>roc(datos$Y, fitted(modelo))$auc</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>pROC</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</div>
